verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat generates automated insights (summaries, action items, next steps, sentiment/keyword analysis) directly from meeting data, and this is well documented across product pages and enterprise materials (otter-docs-1,3,4,21,37,42). Community evidence corroborates real usage of the transcription/summary core, though it focuses mostly on privacy concerns rather than disputing insight quality. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of AI-generated insight accuracy/usefulness (community comments mention accuracy issues with accents and 'absurd, inaccurate outline' in one case), and no rigorous benchmark of insight quality beyond vendor claims.
